- Subscription and advertising revenues constitute the primary sources of income and may be influenced by competitive intensity, economic conditions and changes in advertising spending patterns.
- Intense competition from traditional broadcasters, OTT platforms and digital-first content providers has increased pressure on audience acquisition, content investments and advertising revenues; changing consumer preferences and evolving viewing habits require continuous innovation and timely adaptation of content strategies.

Mitigated by a conservative policy permitting investments only into AAA rated instruments and avoiding equity, real estate and long-dated securities.
- Delays in the collection of accounts receivable could affect the Company's cash flow, with poor follow-up potentially leading to delinquency and write-offs; mitigated by constant monitoring and periodic review of debtors.

- Continue investing in digital platforms, content creation and distribution to strengthen the competitive position
- Diversify revenue streams through movie production and distribution and the international cricket franchise …
